# mdeverything

> Free browser app to read, comment on and edit Markdown documents, then export a clean, structured context package for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Formerly named Marginalia.

mdeverything runs entirely in the browser. There is no sign-up, no server, and no data
leaves the user's device. The user opens a Markdown document, leaves inline comments on any
passage (with replies and resolve), optionally edits the source in a built-in Markdown
editor, and exports a structured bundle (quoted passage, section location, surrounding
context, comments and replies) to paste into an AI assistant for review.

## Features
- Inline comments anchored to passages, Claude-artifact style (preview, card, replies, resolve)
- Margin button to comment on a whole paragraph, list item, heading or table cell
- Optional comments panel with a resolved filter
- Document outline with scroll-spy
- Markdown editor with formatting toolbar, shortcuts and live preview
- Paper, Sepia and Night reading themes
- Autosave of the document, comments and preferences in the browser (localStorage)
- Export modes: full context, notes only, or raw Markdown
- Renders GitHub-flavored Markdown and Mermaid diagrams
- 100% client-side: no tracking, no account, no upload
